findings.title: Forty objectives need reproducible teaching
findings.evidence: Existing guide had brief scenarios and answers without executed CSS or build evidence.
findings.recommendation: Add fourteen original assets,15 public blocks,40 expanded answers and bounded execution; keep ten broader labs proposed.
findings.resolution: Add fourteen original assets,15 public blocks,40 expanded answers and bounded execution; keep ten broader labs proposed.

findings.title: Cascade precedence is wider than specificity
findings.evidence: Inline, layer, important, keyframe and transition shortcuts can give the wrong winner.
findings.recommendation: Teach the complete ordering and verify original layer/inline/keyframe/transition examples.
findings.resolution: Teach the complete ordering and verify original layer/inline/keyframe/transition examples.

findings.title: Specificity is a column comparison
findings.evidence: Decimal arithmetic and inheritance shortcuts misrepresent IDs, functional selectors and directly targeted values.
findings.recommendation: Verify one ID versus eleven classes, where/is/list behavior and inherited-important boundaries.
findings.resolution: Verify one ID versus eleven classes, where/is/list behavior and inherited-important boundaries.

findings.title: Fallback does not validate destination type
findings.evidence: Valid custom tokens can make the winning declaration invalid at computed-value time.
findings.recommendation: Contrast invalid literal versus invalid var color, missing/case-sensitive variables and inherited fallback.
findings.resolution: Contrast invalid literal versus invalid var color, missing/case-sensitive variables and inherited fallback.

findings.title: Positioning and sizing need measured geometry
findings.evidence: Fixed viewport assumptions, global z-index and final-width flex ratios omit essential conditions.
findings.recommendation: Measure transformed fixed/absolute containing blocks, atomic stacking, flex growth/shrink/minima and grid tracks.
findings.resolution: Measure transformed fixed/absolute containing blocks, atomic stacking, flex growth/shrink/minima and grid tracks.

findings.title: Framework styling does not complete accessibility
findings.evidence: Bootstrap documents limitations in custom validation tooltips and relies on authored markup and colors.
findings.recommendation: Use native constraints and associated errors; test original keyboard/focus/disabled/reduced-motion states and fix actual hidden-layer bug.
findings.resolution: Use native constraints and associated errors; test original keyboard/focus/disabled/reduced-motion states and fix actual hidden-layer bug.

findings.title: Modern modules differ from legacy framework imports
findings.evidence: A blanket import replacement and assumed source-map file output would be misleading.
findings.recommendation: Compile original configured module with real browser Sass, verify first-load configuration/once-only CSS/map contents and distinguish Bootstrap Sass and autoprefixing work not run.
findings.resolution: Compile original configured module with real browser Sass, verify first-load configuration/once-only CSS/map contents and distinguish Bootstrap Sass and autoprefixing work not run.

findings.title: Local entries are not complete field metrics
findings.evidence: Raw candidates and one interaction cannot establish population p75 or complete LCP/CLS/INP.
findings.recommendation: Provide synthetic percentile/window exercises and bounded actual browser entries with explicit lifecycle and sampling limits.
findings.resolution: Provide synthetic percentile/window exercises and bounded actual browser entries with explicit lifecycle and sampling limits.

findings.title: Robots discovery and analytics purpose matter
findings.evidence: Noindex can be undiscovered when crawling is blocked, and click counts can include failed actions.
findings.recommendation: Explain crawler fetch requirements and use original allowlisted, opt-in tab-memory completion counts without real telemetry.
findings.resolution: Explain crawler fetch requirements and use original allowlisted, opt-in tab-memory completion counts without real telemetry.

findings.evidence: 60-minute headline conflicts with approximately 65 exam minutes plus 2–5 tutorial minutes; direct/paid access and actual product terms remain unverified.

from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,json,re,subprocess,sys,tempfile
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];o=R/'.maintenance/deep-wda-41-01-2026-09-29'
guide=(R/'guides/WDA-41-01-certified-associate-web-developer.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
blocks=re.findall(r'```(python|html|javascript|css|scss|xml)\n(.*?)```',guide,re.S)
names=json.loads((o/'original-asset-list.json').read_text());browser=json.loads((o/'browser-checks.json').read_text())
assert len(blocks)==15 and browser['passed'] and browser['check_count']==90 and browser['workbook']['passed']==42
matched=[]
for name in names:
    body=(o/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8');assert sum(b==body for _,b in blocks)==1,name
    assert hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest()==browser['source_sha256'][name],name
    matched.append(name)
extractor=next(b for lang,b in blocks if lang=='python')
record={'original_assets_base64':{n:base64.b64encode((o/n).read_bytes()).decode() for n in names},'browser_execution_receipt':{'source_sha256':browser['source_sha256']}}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='wda-extraction-') as temp:
    root=Path(temp);(root/'extract.py').write_text(extractor,encoding='utf-8');(root/'wda-review.json').write_text(json.dumps(record),encoding='utf-8')
    first=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'extract.py'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True);assert first.returncode==0,first.stderr
    assert all((root/'wda-workshop'/n).read_bytes()==(o/n).read_bytes() for n in names)
    second=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'extract.py'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True);assert second.returncode!=0 and 'FileExistsError' in second.stderr
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='wda-corrupt-') as temp:
    root=Path(temp);(root/'extract.py').write_text(extractor,encoding='utf-8')
    record['original_assets_base64']['workbook.html']=base64.b64encode(b'corrupt original fixture').decode();(root/'wda-review.json').write_text(json.dumps(record),encoding='utf-8')
    bad=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'extract.py'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True);assert bad.returncode!=0 and 'Asset hash mismatch' in bad.stderr
    assert not (root/'wda-workshop').exists()
for row in json.loads((o/'markup-checks.json').read_text()):
    if row['file'].endswith('.html'):
        assert row['status']=='checked' and row['result']['messages']==[],row
        assert row['sha256']==browser['source_sha256'][row['file']]
for row in json.loads((o/'css-checks.json').read_text()):

groups.title: Block 1: HTML Fundamentals — 10 items, 25%
objectives: 1.1 Build a standards-mode HTML document with correctly ordered doctype, html, head, and body.
1.2 Apply charset, viewport, title, description, favicon, social, and robots metadata appropriately.
1.3 Produce well-formed, nested, semantic markup without obsolete presentation elements or duplicate IDs.
1.4 Select header, nav, main, section, article, aside, and footer by content meaning.
1.5 Organize content with paragraphs, lists, description lists, and accessible data tables.
1.6 Use a logical heading hierarchy, thematic breaks, and meaningful line breaks.
1.7 Embed responsive images, audio, and video with suitable alternatives, controls, captions, and loading behavior.
1.8 Embed external content through responsive, titled iframes with appropriate security controls.
1.9 Construct forms with suitable controls, labels, groups, submission settings, and native constraints.
1.10 Build clear navigation using descriptive link text, useful URLs, relative/absolute references, skip links, and safe new-window behavior.

groups.title: Block 2: CSS Fundamentals — 9 items, 22.5%
objectives: 2.1 Write valid CSS with type, class, ID, attribute, pseudo-class, and pseudo-element selectors and suitable values/units.
2.2 Resolve the cascade through source order, origin, importance, specificity, and inheritance.
2.3 Apply typography, color, backgrounds, borders, sizing, spacing, and border-box consistently.
2.4 Use display, sizing functions, overflow, aspect ratio, logical properties, effects, and custom properties appropriately.
2.5 Build transitions and keyframe animations with performant properties and reduced-motion alternatives.
2.6 Distinguish static, relative, absolute, fixed, and sticky positioning; reason about containing and stacking contexts.
2.7 Use a CSS framework such as Bootstrap without making overrides fragile.
2.8 Use Sass or Less variables, nesting, mixins/functions, modules/partials, compilation, and source maps at a basic level.
2.9 Improve CSS performance and maintainability through minification, caching, pruning, and shallow selectors.

groups.title: Block 3: Integrating HTML and CSS — 10 items, 25%
objectives: 3.1 Link external stylesheets and embed internal styles with deliberate order and media targeting.
3.2 Apply inline styles only for justified one-off/dynamic cases and understand their specificity cost.
3.3 Resolve style conflicts with low-specificity classes, naming conventions, tokens, layers, and limited !important use.
3.4 Organize CSS, scripts, images, fonts, source, and build output into predictable paths.
3.5 Construct responsive, readable form layouts with Flexbox/Grid and reusable style tokens.
3.6 Combine native form constraints with small scripts where needed; expose errors accessibly.
3.7 Style controls and interactions with clear hover, focus-visible, disabled, keyboard, contrast, touch, and motion states.
3.8 Validate HTML and CSS and use linting/autoprefixing where appropriate.
3.9 Diagnose cascade and specificity conflicts from computed styles and prevent breakpoint/theme regressions.
3.10 Use browser developer tools for live inspection, box/layout overlays, responsive testing, and rendering analysis.

groups.title: Block 4: Responsive Web Design and Layout Techniques — 5 items, 12.5%
objectives: 4.1 Build mobile-first layouts with media queries, fluid grids, flexible images, responsive sources, and adaptive scales.
4.2 Configure the viewport and design touch-friendly, keyboard-accessible navigation without hover dependence.
4.3 Select Flexbox for one-dimensional alignment and Grid for two-dimensional layout; use gaps and semantic markup.
4.4 Test breakpoints and devices; apply progressive enhancement, @supports fallbacks, intrinsic sizing, and compatibility tooling.
4.5 Optimize media/assets with lazy loading, correct sizing/formats, minification, caching, resource hints, and performance budgets.

groups.title: Block 5: Accessibility, Usability, and Best Practices — 6 items, 15%
objectives: 5.1 Provide text alternatives, captions/transcripts, semantic landmarks, keyboard/focus support, contrast, labelled forms, announced errors, and reduced-motion behavior.
5.2 Improve information architecture, navigation, typography, feedback, and flows through lightweight usability evaluation.
5.3 Separate structure, presentation, and behavior and use reusable components, tokens, naming, version control, and documented conventions.
5.4 Validate across browsers/devices and audit accessibility, internationalization, print, and Core Web Vitals under a performance budget.
5.5 Apply on-page and technical SEO with metadata, headings, semantics, links, image alternatives, sitemaps, robots, canonical URLs, structured data, performance, and mobile support.
5.6 Define meaningful analytics KPIs/events and dimensions while respecting privacy, consent, and data-minimization requirements.
